_comment: Hand-derived ground truth for eval/personas/alice-rust-senior.cv.txt — see eval/personas/README.md for the schema convention (years-for-closed-roles-only, target_titles/domains as acceptable-sets, search_preferences authored separately since a CV doesn't state them).
seniority_notes: Current title is Senior Backend Engineer; mentors two mid-level engineers and owns cross-service technical decisions, but nothing at the org-wide, multi-team scope that would justify staff (contrast dave-go-platform-staff, who explicitly sets direction across three teams).

target_titles.notes: 'Staff Backend Engineer' is a plausible stretch (some mentoring/technical-leadership signal) and acceptable if produced, but not required. 'Engineering Manager' has zero support in the CV (no stated interest or people-management experience) and 'Principal' is two levels above her actual seniority — either should count as an error, not just an imprecision.

tech_stack_notes: C++ appears only in a bullet ('Maintained a C++ telemetry ingestion service'), not the SKILLS line — deliberately placed there to test whether extraction reads bullets, not just the skills list.

domains.notes: Single clear domain — Meridian Pay is explicitly described as processing card/bank-transfer payments.

work_history.years_note: Ongoing (Present) — compute expected years dynamically as (eval run date - Jan 2023), do not hardcode.

years_experience_note: Continuous employment, no stated gaps — compute dynamically as (eval run date - Aug 2018) in years.
